name: VisuallyHidden
description: Hides content visually while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Used for icon labels, skip links, and supplementary context.

do: Use VisuallyHidden to provide accessible labels for icon-only buttons
Use inside form elements to add context for screen readers
Use for skip navigation link text
doNot: Do not use to hide content that should be visible — it is only for a11y content
Do not use display:none or visibility:hidden — those hide from screen readers too

accessibility.notes: This component uses the standard visually-hidden CSS technique. Content remains in the accessibility tree and is announced by screen readers.
